title: DES Foodcrust Protein Extraction Protocol
author: Joannes Dekker
materials: Desalting of the samples using C18 StageTips.

steps.title: Prepare DES solution
steps.instruction: Combine urea and guanidine hydrochloride (GuHCl) in a 2:1 molar ratio, heat the mixture to 75‑80 °C until it becomes a clear liquid (≈1 h), then keep it molten for an additional 20 min to ensure mixing. Note that the DES will precipitate on cooling; reheating is possible but fresh preparation is recommended.

steps.title: Extract proteins with DES
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of the hot DES solution to 10‑20 mg of food‑crust material, vortex to mix, and incubate in a heating block at 65 °C for 4 h. Pre‑heat pipette tips and work quickly because the DES cools and crashes out rapidly.

steps.title: Dilute extracts and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Remove the tubes from the heating block, add 500 µL purified water to each, vortex thoroughly to homogenize, then centrifuge for at least 15 min at 15 000 rcf.

steps.title: Reduce and alkylate proteins
steps.instruction: To each supernatant add 15 µL of 100 mM TCEP and 15 µL of 100 mM CAA solution, vortex, centrifuge at 15 000 rcf for 1 min, and incubate in a heating block at 99 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Condition StageTips (MeOH)
steps.instruction: Load each StageTip with 150 µL 100 % methanol and centrifuge at 1 000 rcf for 1 min (or until all methanol has passed through).

steps.title: Equilibrate StageTips (80% ACN/TFA)
steps.instruction: Load 150 µL 80 % acetonitrile containing 0.1 % TFA onto each tip and centrifuge at 1 000 rcf for 2 min (or until complete flow‑through).

steps.title: Equilibrate StageTips (0.1% TFA)
steps.instruction: Load 150 µL 0.1 % TFA onto each tip and centrifuge at 1 000 rcf for 2 min (or until complete flow‑through).

steps.title: Load samples onto StageTips
steps.instruction: Load 150 µL of the reduced/alkylated sample onto the StageTip, centrifuge at 1 000 rcf until the liquid passes through, then repeat with another 150 µL. Continue loading in 150 µL increments until the entire sample is applied (typically six loadings). A single loading may require up to 20 min; centrifugation times of 5‑10 min are often sufficient. Ensure no residual food‑crust pellet is transferred to avoid tip blockage.

steps.title: Wash StageTips with TFA
steps.instruction: Load 150 µL 0.1 % TFA onto each tip and centrifuge at 1 000 rcf until complete flow‑through (≈2 min 30 s). Repeat this wash once more for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Elute proteins from StageTips
steps.instruction: Load 50 µL 50 % acetonitrile containing 0.1 % TFA onto each tip and centrifuge at 700 rcf for 3 min. Collect the flow‑through, which contains the eluted proteins.

steps.title: Dry and resolubilize eluates
steps.instruction: Place the eluates in a speed‑vacuum and dry to near‑dry (still slightly wet) by incubating 45 min at 45 °C. Then re‑solubilise each sample in 100 µL 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (ABC). Note: a P1000 tip placed tip‑side up fits a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, allowing evaporation through the filter while limiting contamination.

steps.title: Optional protein quantification aliquot
steps.instruction: If desired, remove a 10 µL aliquot from each sample for a Bradford or BCA protein assay.

steps.title: Sequential chymotrypsin digestion
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of a 0.4 µg/µL chymotrypsin solution to each sample and incubate at 25 °C for 18 h.

steps.title: Sequential trypsin digestion
steps.instruction: After the chymotrypsin step, add 1 µL of a 0.4 µg/µL trypsin solution to each sample and incubate at 37 °C for 18 h.

steps.title: Post‑digestion cleanup and acidify
steps.instruction: Following trypsin digestion, centrifuge the samples for 1 min at 13 000 rcf, then add 10 µL of 5 % (v/v) TFA to each to acidify.

steps.title: Prepare Evotips (Solvent B)
steps.instruction: Load 20 µL of Solvent B (0.1 % formic acid in acetonitrile) onto each Evotip and centrifuge at 700 rcf for 60 s.

steps.title: Condition Evotip filters with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Place the filtered tips of the Evotips in isopropanol until the filters change from ivory‑white to pale‑white (minimum 10 s). An easy method is to fill the bottom of an empty pipette‑tip box with isopropanol and transfer the Evotip insert into it.

steps.title: Equilibrate Evotips with Solvent A
steps.instruction: Load 20 µL of Solvent A (0.1 % formic acid in water) onto each Evotip and centrifuge at 700 rcf for 60 s.

steps.title: Load sample onto Evotips
steps.instruction: Load 20 µL of the digested sample onto each Evotip and centrifuge at 700 rcf for 60 s.

steps.title: Wash Evotips
steps.instruction: Load 20 µL of Solvent A (0.1 % formic acid) onto each Evotip, centrifuge at 700 rcf for 60 s, and repeat for a total of three washes. If samples are very dirty, a larger wash volume may be used, but ensure that no flow‑through contacts the bottom of the tip box.

steps.title: Final storage of Evotip samples
steps.instruction: Load 100‑150 µL of 0.1 % formic acid onto each Evotip, centrifuge at 700 rcf for 10 s so the solution sits on the filter. Samples are ready for short‑term storage; for long‑term storage keep the filters wet by filling the bottom of the tip box with 0.1 % formic acid so it contacts the filters.
